title: Firestore data is readable without authentication: student marks / parent portal data
detail: An unauthenticated Firestore REST request returned HTTP 200 for `schools/main/public/parentMarks`. Only the authorization status and field names were inspected; field values were not stored or printed.
fix: Restrict Firestore Security Rules so this path requires an authenticated, authorized user. Do not rely on a client-side PIN gate. If parents must read their own child's data, use a per-student document with rules that check the authenticated UID and custom claims, or serve it through a Cloud Function.

title: Accountant login is enforced only in client-side JavaScript
detail: The password comparison happens in the browser, so it can be bypassed by editing JavaScript or reading local storage. It is not an authentication boundary.
fix: Enforce authentication and authorization on the server (Firebase Auth + Security Rules or a backend API). Treat the client-side password only as a local UX lock.

title: Hard-coded default password in client code
detail: A fallback password is embedded in JavaScript. If it is not changed, anyone who views the source can enter the protected panel.
fix: Remove the fallback. Provision a unique password during setup, force a change on first login, and enforce server-side/Firebase Auth.

title: Password is included in exported backup data
detail: A backup/export function reads the account password and includes it in a downloadable JSON file.
fix: Never export passwords or PINs. Encrypt backups or omit credential fields entirely.

title: Sensitive credential stored in localStorage
detail: The code writes a password/token-like key into browser storage. Any script on the origin, or anyone with device access, can read it.
fix: Do not store passwords or plaintext PINs in Web Storage. Use httpOnly, Secure cookies or Firebase Auth tokens and store only non-reversible hashes when offline verification is required.

title: Content-Security-Policy header is missing
detail: The site has no CSP. Because this page contains a very large amount of inline JavaScript, any injected script would execute with full access to the DOM, Firebase session and local data.
fix: Add a CSP at the host/CDN. Start with a safe minimum such as `frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'` and then add script-src using hashes/nonces after testing.

title: Accessibility: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
detail: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds Affected nodes: 1.
evidence: button[onclick="doFirebaseLogin()"] | Fix any of the following: Element has insufficient color contrast of 3.76 (foreground color: #ffffff, background color: #059669, font size: 9.8pt (13px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1
fix: See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/color-contrast?application=axeAPI

title: Home page HTML is over 1 MB
detail: The HTML document is 1.8 MB.
evidence: HTML bytes=1912534; inline JS=1600207; inline CSS=142249
fix: Move inline code to cacheable static assets and remove unused code.

title: Large HTML is marked no-store and cannot be cached
detail: The 1.8 MB HTML document is sent with `Cache-Control: no-store`, so every navigation downloads the whole document again, even when only a tiny part changed.
evidence: Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate; HTML bytes=1912534
fix: Split the inline JavaScript/CSS into versioned static files with long cache lifetimes, and cache the small HTML shell. Keep no-store only on authenticated API responses if needed.

title: Most JavaScript is inline and uncacheable
detail: 1.5 MB of JavaScript is embedded in the HTML document.
fix: Extract JavaScript into hashed .js files served with long cache lifetimes.

title: Clickjacking protection is missing
detail: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors prevents framing.
fix: Add `X-Frame-Options: DENY` and `frame-ancestors 'none'`.

title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff is missing
detail: Browsers may MIME-sniff responses and execute content incorrectly.
fix: Add `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`.

title: Accessibility: All page content should be contained by landmarks
detail: Ensure all page content is contained by landmarks Affected nodes: 12.
evidence: .modal-box > div:nth-child(1) | Fix any of the following: Some page content is not contained by landmarks .modal-box > div:nth-child(2) | Fix any of the following: Some page content is not contained by landmarks .modal-box > p:nth-child(3) | Fix any of the following: Some page content is not contained by landmarks
fix: See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/region?application=axeAPI

title: Password fields do not declare autocomplete
detail: Missing autocomplete on: loginPassword. Password managers may behave inconsistently.
fix: Use autocomplete="current-password" for login and "new-password" for registration.

title: Firebase App Check does not appear to be initialized
detail: Without App Check, scripted clients can call Firebase APIs with the public web key more easily.
fix: Enable App Check (reCAPTCHA Enterprise/App Attest) and enforce it for Firestore and Auth.

title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is missing
detail: Cross-window attacks such as XS-Leaks are not mitigated.
fix: Add `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin` after testing popups.

title: Permissions-Policy header is missing
detail: Browser features (camera, microphone, geolocation) are not restricted.
fix: Add `Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()`.

title: Referrer-Policy header is missing
detail: URLs (which may contain student IDs or tokens) can leak in the Referer header.
fix: Add `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin` or `no-referrer`.

title: Third-party scripts/styles have no Subresource Integrity
detail: 3 cross-origin resource(s) are not pinned to a known hash.
fix: Add integrity + crossorigin to third-party assets when the CDN supports CORS.

title: axe-core reported 3 accessibility rule violation(s)
detail: See the individual AXE_* findings for selectors and fixes.
fix: Fix high-impact violations first (ARIA roles, names, contrast, forms).

title: Form controls lack explicit labels in static HTML
detail: 227 controls have no <label for>, aria-label or title. Some may be hidden tab panels; the browser axe scan checks the visible ones.
fix: Associate every visible control with a <label for> or aria-label.

title: Firebase configuration is present in public HTML
detail: Firebase web apps must expose the project ID and web API key. This is not a secret by itself; protection depends on Security Rules and App Check.
fix: Verify Firestore/Storage Rules with the emulator, restrict the API key to your domains, and enable App Check.

title: Google/Firebase API key exposed in the page (normal for Firebase web apps)
detail: A Google/Firebase API key is present in the public HTML. This is normal for Firebase web apps, but the key must be restricted by Firebase Security Rules, API restrictions and App Check.
fix: Do not treat the web API key as a secret. Verify Firestore/Storage rules deny unauthenticated access and enable Firebase App Check.

title: Page uses inline event handlers
detail: 379 onclick/onchange-style attributes make CSP hardening harder.
fix: Move event handlers into external JavaScript and use addEventListener.
